entities.name: Order of Stromgald
entities.description: Ethno-nationalist Kjeldoran political movement secretly formed by Avram Garrison and Lim-Dul to assassinate King Darien; later undead knights.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Nation on Dominaria during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Marton Stromgald
entities.description: Legendary Kjeldoran general after whom the Order is named.

entities.name: Darien
entities.description: King of Kjeldor targeted by the Order; killed Haakon in the Battle of Kjeldor.

entities.name: Avram Garrison
entities.description: Former Kjeldoran knight who formed the Order with Lim-Dul.

entities.name: Lim-Dul
entities.description: Necromancer and archenemy of Kjeld who turned the Order into undead.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Defender of King Darien who later returned to Tresserhorn.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Defender of King Darien who later returned to Tresserhorn.

entities.name: Tresserhorn
entities.description: Keep where Lim-Dul turned the Order into undead and which they later besieged and took.

entities.name: Lord of Tresserhorn
entities.description: Creation of Chaeska destroyed by Jodah and Jaya.

entities.name: Haakon
entities.description: Undead leader of the Knights of Stromgald, killed by King Darien.

entities.name: Heidar
entities.description: Rimewind leader who convinced Haakon to ally.

entities.name: Battle of Kjeldor
entities.description: Battle in which Haakon was killed by King Darien.

entities.name: Lim-Dul's Battle
entities.description: Battle in which most of the undead knights died.

events.summary: The Order, a front for Avram Garrison and Lim-Dul, stages a coup to assassinate King Darien; Jodah, Jaya Ballard, Gustha Ebbasdotter and Varchild foil it.
events.quote: Their staged coup was foiled by Jodah , Jaya Ballard , Gustha Ebbasdotter , and Varchild defending the king

events.summary: The Order withdraws to Tresserhorn, where Lim-Dul turns them all into undead.
events.quote: where Lim-Dûl turned them all into undead

events.summary: Most undead knights die in Lim-Dul's Battle.
events.quote: where most of them were killed

events.summary: The Stromgald undead besiege Tresserhorn, led by Chaeska's defenders in a twenty-year stalemate.
events.quote: For twenty years, a stalemate held

events.summary: Jodah and Jaya return in 2954 AR and destroy the Lord of Tresserhorn, breaking the balance.
events.quote: But Jodah and Jaya returned there in 2954 AR , and destroyed the Lord of Tresserhorn.

events.summary: The Knights of Stromgald overpower Chaeska and take over Tresserhorn under Haakon.
events.quote: The Knights of Stromgald eventually overpowered Chaeska and his skeletal guard

events.summary: Heidar convinces a hesitant Haakon to ally with the Rimewind.
events.quote: Although Haakon was initially hesitant, Heidar convinced him to ally.

events.summary: In the Battle of Kjeldor, King Darien kills Haakon.
events.quote: where their leader, Haakon, was killed by King Darien

relations.quote: The Order was formed by former Kjeldoran knight Avram Garrison and the necromancer
where their leader, Haakon, was killed by King Darien
